Data: Satrix 40 daily total return 2010-01-05 to 2026-10-29. Training (in-sample) 2010-2019, test (out-of-sample) 2020-2026. Costs 0.40% per buy or sell. Trades placed the day after the signal.

Strategy variants tried: 57

**Overall winner in training:** Bollinger 50d 1.5sd (Sharpe 0.45 vs buy-and-hold 0.13). With 57 variants tried, luck alone would produce a best Sharpe of about 1.13. Deflated Sharpe: probability the edge is real = 1%.

In the test years it returned 12.9% a year (Sharpe 0.53) vs buy-and-hold 10.9% (Sharpe 0.32).

Rank correlation between training and test Sharpe across all 57 variants: 0.69 (1 = training predicts test perfectly, 0 = no relation). Variants that beat buy-and-hold's Sharpe in the test years: 10 of 56. Variants that beat its return: 5 of 56.
